concept.title: Pi’s ribbon
concept.notation: r ∈ ℝ, r > 0; C is circumference; d = 2r; π = 3.141592653589793…
concept.hypotheses: A circle of radius r in the Euclidean plane. Circumference denotes its arc length.
concept.statement: For every such circle, C = 2πr and C/d = π.
concept.visual_mapping: Pi wears a circumference ribbon. Unrolling reveals its length; changing the radius scales both the circle and ribbon.
concept.limitations: A numerical illustration of the circle relation, not a proof. The character and its eyes are decoration; the displayed π is a finite approximation.
concept.source_quote: This is a synthetic demonstration, not an extraction from Gyile’s coursework.
